svg.title: Avery’s synthetic diary: daily steps and sleep versus mood, linked by date
svg.desc: Fifty-six fictional dates from 5 January to 1 March 2026. The steps timeline has 54 defined values and gaps for missing measurements. The sleep and mood scatter has 52 complete pairs. Eight Travel dates are highlighted across both plots; one has no step measurement. All values are invented and provide no health or causal evidence.
svg.text: Avery · 56 dates · 5 Jan – 1 Mar 2026 · all values synthetic
8 Travel dates selected · the same date IDs connect both views
54 step values · 52 complete sleep/mood pairs · missing values remain missing
New VizFootprint companion to the 2014 paper. Invented patterns are not behavioral or medical evidence.
